scope: All14 ordinary M21 planeswalker printings: three-loyalty regular frames and first-static/four-row Teferi frames only. Bounds are fixed in canonical space, not fitted to ink per card. Art, title, type, mana, symbol, rules, ability badges, starting loyalty, credits and silhouette corners have separate fields. Credits remain unverified in weighted scoring. Source/ability guards refuse unsupported populations. This record is not a claim that these components render correctly.
reviewNotes: All14 ink windows were inspected on complete aligned scan contact sheets; the four-row static ability has a wider independent left margin.
Final frame fields were inspected on all14 PCA-aligned source scans. Left fields use gaps between loyalty badges, and right fields stop before the starting-loyalty shield.

Liliana Waker of the Dead changes by up to5.68px at a corner versus V21, while the other13 change by at most0.44px. Its complete old/new/reference geometry was inspected separately; this consistency result alone does not certify global normalization.
No runtime policy or live score version has changed. Connect these windows to a new frozen diagnostic graph and verify ordinary-region scores remain identical before Lab adoption.

A lower-left frame field was initially empty black stock; all14 source regions were rechecked and the shared field moved to the visible curved boundary at27,610,65,22. All14 frame components now pass the existing signal gate. No gate or component weight was relaxed.
Holographic-stamp contour scoring remains pending; reviewed scoring windows do not constitute complete component calibration.
